fired-clay-figurines-venus.description: Three people in dark fur clothing sit around a stone-ringed fire in a dim hut with animal skulls and a large curved bone behind them. The man in front holds a small clay figurine over the flames with a wooden tool. Smaller clay animal and human figurines sit on stone slabs in the foreground, and pine branches lie by the fire. The painting is dark and painterly, fills the frame edge to edge, and shows no visible text.

lime-plaster-burning.description: A night scene in a mud-brick village. In the foreground a bearded man in a loincloth-style tunic prods glowing stones in a pit fire with a long pole, while a second man at left pours water from a jug, sending up steam. A third figure carries a basket of pale stones, and a woman kneels at right beside a flat slab with white powder spread across the ground. There is no visible text, border or frame.

first-copper-smelting-balkans.description: A crouched, shirtless man with matted hair and a fur loincloth blows through a long pipe into a fire. The fire heats a stone-rimmed basin holding green ore pieces, and a molten orange stream runs from it into a clay pot. Another figure sits in shadow behind him, and green ore chunks, a stone tool and charcoal lie on the ground. The setting is a dim rock shelter or hut. No text, numbers or frame are visible, and the image is edge to edge.

varna-gold-grave-treasure.description: A dim, oil-painted scene of a shallow pit lit by torches. A woman in a dark garment lies on her back, covered in gold necklaces, coin discs, bangles and a belt with gold plaques and animal figures. Two bearded men in fur-like clothing kneel at the pit edge, one reaching toward a gold ring. A gold rod lies beside her, with dark ceramic pots nearby. Beyond are cliffs and a grey sea under a dusky sky. No visible text, no frame, and nothing gory.

mesopotamian-kiln-fired-bricks.description: A large dome-shaped kiln of mud or clay with an orange fire glowing at its arched opening, with sparks and smoke rising. Several shirtless men in loincloths stack reddish bricks near the fire, and others carry bricks on their heads. A river with boats and palm trees sits under a sunset sky on the left, and a tall brick wall rises on the right with a figure on top. Stacks of bricks and bundles of sticks lie on the ground.

bronze-alloyed-sumer.description: A bearded, shirtless man in a fur or leather skirt leans over a stone mould, tipping a glowing clay crucible of molten orange metal so a stream pours into a stone block with sparks flying. Behind him on the left is a domed clay furnace glowing with fire. Round copper-coloured discs with green patina and silver-grey ingots sit on the ground, with charcoal, tongs and hammers scattered around. A second figure with a glowing object stands in the dim background. The scene is dark and painterly, with no visible text or frame.

glass-made-mesopotamia.description: Two bearded men in ragged tunics sit in a dim workshop beside a mud-brick furnace with bright fire. One holds a long rod with a glowing orange glass vessel on its end, and the other tends the fire. In the foreground are bowls of pale powder and dark material, and on a woven mat lie small glass beads and a few finished glass bottles and flasks. There is no visible text, border or frame.

mesoamerican-rubber-curing.description: An elderly tattooed man in a loincloth kneads green plant matter in a large wooden bowl of milky white liquid, while a boy pours more white liquid from a gourd. A tree trunk is tapped, with white sap running down a channel into a small pot. Behind them, a toddler reaches for black balls on a mat, and a seated man works with a dark cord. Thatched huts sit in dense jungle with shafts of light, and purple-stemmed plants lie on the ground. There is no visible text, frame or border.

hittite-iron-mastery.description: A bearded man in a rough tunic and leather apron raises a hammer over a glowing orange lump of metal on an anvil, sparks flying. Behind him a row of dark blades and tools hangs on a rack against stone walls, and a hearth fire burns at the right. The painting is dim, warm and fills the frame edge to edge with no text or border.

roman-concrete-perfected.description: An oil-style painting of two bearded men in rough tunics working over a wooden trough, one shovelling dark grey material and the other stirring it with a long wooden paddle. A third man carries a basket of stones, and a brick-arched vault stands in scaffolding behind them beside the sea under a stormy sky. No visible text, no frame, and nothing graphic.
